feature_title: Create a FastAPI todo-list service using uv and Python 3.14 (requires-python >=3.14): an in-memory store with POST /todos, GET /todos, GET /todos/{id}, PATCH /todos/{id} and DELETE /todos/{id}, Pydantic models, 404 for unknown ids, and pytest tests using FastAPI's TestClient, verified by uv run pytest -q.
warnings: The suite never exercises the PATCH re-validation behavior that commit T-2 was specifically written for (store.update's docstring calls out rejecting an explicit `title: null`); manual check confirms PATCH with `{"title": null}` correctly returns 422, but no test pins that down, so a future change could silently drop the safeguard.

The reset_store fixture reaches past TodoStore's public interface into its private attributes (`store._todos`, `store._next_id`) to reset state instead of the store exposing a reset/clear method; this couples the test to TodoStore's internal representation.
